blocks.text: Briefing for James Jones, Chief Financial Officer, Morse PLC. Prepared by Melissa Jacobson with Richard Mccoy and Heather Delacruz.

items: 1. The search opened on {{fact:f:E-2015-001.start}}. We are in the mapping and screening phase, which is where the plan put us at this point.
2. Our universe stands at {{fact:f:E-2015-001.scope}}, built from trade directories, accreditation listings, industry association rosters and our own files.
3. The screen runs against the criteria your board approved. Those criteria have not changed, and the screen is close to finished.
4. Each company that clears the screen gets a one-page profile of the business and of its owner.
5. No owner has been approached yet. First calls wait on your sign-off of the short list.
1. The field is fragmented. Most companies are founder-owned and run from one site or a small regional network.
2. Accreditation divides it. Accredited laboratories hold customers longer and carry more recurring calibration work.
3. Few owners have taken outside capital. Most have never run a sale process and will need the process explained.
4. Pricing across {{fact:f:E-2015-001.comparators}} rewards recurring contract revenue over one-off project testing.
5. Regional roll-ups are already active. Some owners on our list will have heard from one, which shapes how we open the call.
1. We finish the screen and send you the short list, company by company, for sign-off.
2. We agree with you the wording that describes the buyer on a first call. It describes a strategic acquirer and does not use the name.
3. Richard Mccoy begins owner calls in the agreed order once the list is approved. Heather Delacruz reads the call script first.
4. Every call is logged the same day, so you can see where each owner stands at any point.
5. Our weekly call continues. A written status report follows at the midpoint of the engagement.
